summary: Phase 1 Task 1 (Reminder System hardening) verified. TypeScript compiles clean (exit 0, zero errors). Metro bundles without errors — only pre-existing deprecated shadow* and expo-notifications-web warnings observed. Static inspection confirms all spec items for notifications.ts, storage.ts, and VaultContext.tsx. Web E2E regression flow passes end-to-end with no runtime errors: splash -> login-demo-btn -> onboarding-continue-btn -> home tab shows priority-reminder-card -> tab-docs shows 6 doc-cards -> first doc opens -> doc-edit-btn opens edit sheet with edit-name and edit-save-btn visible -> edit-save-btn (no field change) closes the sheet successfully. updateDoc path does NOT throw with new reminder-persistence logic.

e2e_regression.doc_edit_flow_no_change_save: passed (sheet closed cleanly, no runtime errors)

critical_code_review_comments: reminderIdsStore is a module-scoped in-memory Map shared across React fast-refresh reloads and across VaultProviders. Fine for a singleton but could leak if VaultProvider ever mounts twice; low priority.

hydrateReminderStore runs on every user change; if user toggles, stale entries from previous user could linger since reminderIdsStore.clear() runs before rehydrate — acceptable given single-user demo app.
persistReminderStore writes the ENTIRE map on every mutation; O(n) on doc count. Acceptable for demo scale.
